defects.description: TypeError: Comparison between offset-naive (datetime.utcnow()) and offset-aware (self._expires_at) datetimes will raise a TypeError at runtime.

Double-checked locking failure: Multiple threads can pass the initial expiration check simultaneously and then sequentially execute the refresh logic because there is no re-check of the expiration state once the lock is acquired.
Potential KeyError if 'access_token' or 'expires_in' are missing from the API response payload; no validation is performed on the JSON structure.
datetime.utcnow() is deprecated as of Python 3.12; datetime.now(timezone.utc) is the modern, aware-safe alternative.

obvious_bugs: Comparison of naive and aware datetimes (crash on first run).
Race condition in refresh logic (missing double-check inside lock).
notes: The code follows a common architectural pattern for token management but contains a critical runtime error due to Python's strictness regarding naive/aware datetime comparisons. The concurrency bug would lead to redundant API calls under high load.
